items.headline: Hormuz tanker transits collapse amid tension
items.summary: Per Port X Logistics, commodity vessel crossings through the Strait of Hormuz dropped sharply in a single day even as Asia-US ocean rates and the Shanghai Containerized Freight Index kept climbing into Golden Week.

items.headline: First Brands case converts to Chapter 7 liquidation
items.summary: A Houston bankruptcy judge converted the remaining First Brands cases to Chapter 7, per Nelson Mullins, underscoring ongoing lessons for lenders on receivables and supply-chain-finance controls.

items.headline: Molecule details Trilogy integration for gas ETRM
items.summary: Following its acquisition of Trilogy Energy Solutions, Molecule executives outlined plans to stream Trilogy's physical gas operations data into its reporting layer to unify physical and financial gas workflows.

items.headline: ACER tightens REMIT inside-information reporting rules
items.summary: ACER updated its Manual of Procedures on Article 4 inside-information disclosures, per RegTrail, moving toward mandatory EIC codes and immutable UMM lifecycle updates ahead of a December 2026 deadline.
